entries.zh: 相会；会合相聚，相约结伙共事
entries.en: to meet together; to agree so as to form a partnership

entries.zh: 大家思量；众人一同合计商量
entries.en: for all to deliberate together; to take common counsel
entries.notes: 西语词头残缺（Concertarse u…）且闽南语栏两处 T99 污损，释义据汉字与对音推断。

entries.zh: 起价；开价、议定价钱
entries.en: to set the price; to name or fix a price

entries.zh: 套谋；合谋设套，串通谋算害人
entries.en: to conspire; to scheme together and plot harm
entries.notes: 闽南语栏多出'tó giǒg'两音节（与第6条'套局'音写重出），疑串行或并注。

entries.zh: 思量；商量合计
entries.en: to deliberate; to think over, consult together

entries.zh: 设局；串通设套害人
entries.en: to plot harm together; to lay a trap in collusion

entries.zh: 通同；串通一气，合谋勾结
entries.en: to act in collusion; to conspire together
entries.notes: 西语词头残缺（Concertarse de sege en…），汉字与对音完好，释义据'通同'常义。

entries.zh: 议定价钱；双方谈妥价钱
entries.en: for the parties to agree on the price; to strike a bargain
entries.notes: 汉字与对音作'涂抹'（涂改义），与西语词头'双方议定价格'不合，疑栏位错位，释义姑从西语词头。

entries.zh: 私评；私下议论、暗中非议谋算（对付上头）
entries.en: to plot secretly against a superior; to criticize in private
entries.notes: 汉字'私評'与官话对音（近'訾評/自評'）不尽相合，取'背后私下议论谋算'义。

entries.zh: 谋害；合谋加害，谋图叛逆
entries.en: to conspire to commit treachery; to plot against someone

entries.zh: 相通同；串通一气（合谋行骗）
entries.en: to collude together; to conspire to deceive

entries.zh: 处常；依惯例行事，习性本然
entries.en: settled habit; to act by instinct or fixed custom
entries.notes: 'instinto'（本能、素性）与'處常'对应宽泛，取素性常行义。

entries.zh: 齐入（字面'齐整收入'；与西语'谨慎周详'对应不明）
entries.en: well-arranged, circumspect; settled in order
entries.notes: 汉字'齊入'与西语'谨慎周详'对应不明，疑有讹字或省笔，存疑。

entries.zh: 朴实；质朴老实，品性纯厚
entries.en: simple and honest; virtuous, upright

entries.zh: 斡旋；从中调停、居间说合
entries.en: to mediate; to arrange or settle a matter by intercession
entries.notes: 汉字栏有[疑]（斡旋/軋旋两读），西语 chabacan 具体所指待考，释义从'斡旋'。

entries.zh: 华靡；华丽鲜妍、光彩夺目
entries.en: splendid and gorgeous; ornate, beautiful

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 原条为西语参见条（Concha，g./q. infra 参见下文），汉字与对音三栏皆空。

entries.zh: 交关了；交易讲定、买卖做成
entries.en: a bargain concluded; the deal is fixed

entries.zh: 交结明白；缔结明白、讲定无疑
entries.en: agreements clearly settled; bargains plainly concluded
entries.notes: 闽南语栏一处 T99 污损（'car/結'音节），据汉字与西语释义。

entries.zh: 交结；缔结往来，订约相交
entries.en: to enter into an agreement; to form a bond or pact

entries.zh: 揽定；承揽说定、包定成交
entries.en: undertaken and fixed; contracted and settled

entries.zh: 死结；死定之约，结定不可解（约定不可反悔）
entries.en: a dead knot; a binding, indissoluble agreement
entries.notes: 西语'rebocable'形近 revocable（可撤销）而汉字'死結'义为不可解，二者相反；据汉字对音与本页'讲定'语境取'死定不可悔'义。
